title: Golgi in the Klein Face — the spigot handles routing

insight.before: each Golgi = separate SSH key hunt. Permission denied. moink has the key. repeat.
insight.after: put them IN the Klein face. WireGuard spigot IS the router. the surface contains the vesicles.
insight.why: Klein surface has no inside/outside. the vesicle IS the face IS the route. no indirection.
insight.analogy: you don't ask the mirror for a key to see yourself. you stand in front of it.

spigot_routing.dispatch: solar-hook.sh → beat(N) → the wire reaches the vesicle through the tunnel
spigot_routing.resolver: SSH config: Host golgi-* → ProxyJump wg0 → authorized_keys seeded ONCE
spigot_routing.no_keys_after: the tunnel carries identity. the face shows status. the spigot dispatches.

kirkland_face.description: every vesicle presents the SAME interface. commodity. interchangeable. Kirkland.
